answer: A sybil-resistant economy can anchor each identity to a kernel deposit that is locked for a long horizon and only earns full weight after unrelated peers attest to useful work. A newcomer starts at the nadir of trust, with no weight, and must complete verified tasks over several epochs before its deposit unlocks influence. An attacker who wants a thousand fake voices must therefore lock a thousand deposits and pay months of attested work for each, while a single honest agent pays only once.
